Attackers can obtain template ids from the unguarded list endpoint and overwrite system notification titles and content, delivering attacker-supplied text or links to other users.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/log/deleteBatch
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysLogController deleteBatch handler that allows any authenticated user to delete system audit log entries. Low-privileged attackers can send a DELETE request with ids set to allclear to wipe the entire sys_log table, erasing all users' audit trails.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via saveDeptRolePermission Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saveDeptRolePermission endpoint of SysDepartPermissionController that allows any authenticated user to modify department role permissions. Low-privileged attackers can submit roleId and permissionIds values to grant arbitrary menu or button permissions, escalating privileges or revoking other users' permissions.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/sysDepartPermission/add
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to create department permission bindings via POST /sys/sysDepartPermission/add. Attackers can submit arbitrary departId, permissionId and dataRuleIds fields to attach menu, button and data rule grants to any department for delegation to its roles.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/user/deleteGroupUser
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to remove group memberships via the deleteGroupUser handler in SysUserController. Attackers can send DELETE requests with arbitrary groupId and userId values to remove any user from any administrator-maintained user group without ownership or tenant checks.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/category/deleteBatch
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete category dictionary entries via DELETE /sys/category/deleteBatch. Attackers can obtain node ids from the unguarded rootList and childList endpoints and submit them to recursively delete entire sys_category subtrees, breaking dependent forms and dictionary fields.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via getDynamicDbSourceByCode Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET /sys/api/getDynamicDbSourceByCode endpoint of SystemApiController, which lacks Shiro permission or role annotations. Any authenticated low-privileged user can supply datasource codes in the dbSourceCode parameter to retrieve JDBC URLs, usernames and decrypted cleartext database passwords.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via GET /openapi/list
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the queryPageList handler of OpenApiController that allows any authenticated user to list OpenAPI registry definitions. Low-privileged attackers can query GET /openapi/list to read virtual paths, internal origin URLs, IP whitelists, and header and parameter templates intended for administrators.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/tenant/queryTenantAuthInfo
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysTenantController queryTenantAuthInfo handler that allows any authenticated user to read other tenants' records. Low-privileged attackers can iterate small integer tenant ids to retrieve full sys_tenant records, including house numbers used as tenant join codes and company profile fields.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/tenant/deleteApply
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysTenantController deleteApply handler that allows any authenticated user to reject tenant administrator applications. Low-privileged attackers can send PUT requests with chosen tenantId, packId and userId values to delete pending applications in any tenant and notify applicants of rejection.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/prompts/deleteRecycleBin
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragPromptsController deleteRecycleBin handler that allows any authenticated user to purge AI prompt templates. Low-privileged attackers can send DELETE requests with prompt template ids to permanently remove recycle-bin templates belonging to administrators or other users.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/prompts/exportXls
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragPromptsController exportXls handler that allows any authenticated user to export all AI prompts. Low-privileged attackers can request /airag/prompts/exportXls to download every user's prompts, including prompt content, model ids, and parameters, as an Excel workbook.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/api/queryUserRoles
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the queryUserRoles handler of SystemApiController that lets authenticated users read any user's role codes. Low-privileged attackers can send GET requests to /sys/api/queryUserRoles with an arbitrary username to enumerate role assignments and identify administrator accounts.

title: mall4j through 4.0 Operator Precedence Error Exposes Other Users' Cart Items via /p/shopCart/expiryProdList
desc: mall4j through 4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to read other shoppers' cart items due to an operator precedence error in the getShopCartExpiryItems SQL filter. Attackers with any storefront account can request GET /p/shopCart/expiryProdList to retrieve off-shelf product basket entries including product, SKU, quantity, shop, and promoter card

title: Photoshop Desktop | NULL Pointer Dereference (CWE-476)
desc: Photoshop Desktop is affected by a NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability that could result in an application denial-of-service. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to crash the application, leading to a denial-of-service condition. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

title: ColdFusion | Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863)
desc: ColdFusion is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

title: ColdFusion | Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference ('XXE') (CWE-611)
desc: ColdFusion is affected by an Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference ('XXE') vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary file system read. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive files and directories outside the intended access scope. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

title: ColdFusion | Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (CWE-400)
desc: ColdFusion is affected by an Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability that could lead to application denial-of-service. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to exhaust system resources, resulting in an application denial-of-service condition. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction.

desc:

title: easy-pdf-merge 0.1.0 through 0.2.6 OS Command Injection via merge function
desc: easy-pdf-merge 0.1.0 through 0.2.6 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute commands by injecting shell metacharacters into source paths, destination path, or maxHeap option. Attackers can supply file names or options containing double quotes, semicolons, $() or backticks, which child_process.exec() runs through a shell with the Node.js process privileges.

title: Org.keycloak:keycloak-quarkus-server: sensitive data exposure in keycloak build process
desc: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This issue occurs because sensitive runtime values, such as passwords, may be captured during the Keycloak build process and embedded as default values in bytecode, leading to unintended information disclosure. title: HoloViz Panel from 1.2.2 before 1.9.0 Open Redirect via next Parameter
desc: HoloViz Panel from 1.2.2 before 1.9.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in panel/auth.py that allows remote attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated next query parameter. BasicLoginHandler and PasswordLoginHandler store the parameter in a next_url cookie, so crafted login links send victims to attacker-controlled external sites after successful login.

title: Submariner-operator: rbac permissions can allow for the spread of node compromises
desc: A flaw was found in the Submariner project. Due to unnecessary role-based access control permissions, a privileged attacker can run a malicious container on a node that may allow them to steal service account tokens and further compromise other nodes and potentially the entire cluster.

title: Org.keycloak/keycloak-quarkus-server: keycloak proxy header handling denial-of-service (dos) vulnerability
desc: A vulnerability was found in the Keycloak Server. The Keycloak Server is vulnerable to a denial of service (DoS) attack due to improper handling of proxy headers. When Keycloak is configured to accept incoming proxy headers, it may accept non-IP values, such as obfuscated identifiers, without proper validation. This issue can lead to costly DNS resolution operations, which an attacker could exploi

title: Grub2: commands/dump: the dump command is not in lockdown when secure boot is enabled
desc: A flaw was found in grub2. Grub's dump command is not blocked when grub is in lockdown mode, which allows the user to read any memory information, and an attacker may leverage this in order to extract signatures, salts, and other sensitive information from the memory.

title: Out of bounds read when calling crc16_ansi and strlen in dns_validate_msg
desc: A malicious or malformed DNS packet without a payload can cause an out-of-bounds read, resulting in a crash (denial of service) or an incorrect computation.

title: Out of bounds read when unpacking DNS answers
desc: A lack of input validation allows for out of bounds reads caused by malicious or malformed packets.

title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Out-of-Bound Write in gen_prov_start
desc: There is a potential OOB Write vulnerability in the gen_prov_start function in pb_adv.c. The full length of the received data is copied into the link.rx.buf receiver buffer without any validation on the data size.

desc: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a custom role with compliance framework administration permissions to configure and execute a specially crafted compliance pipeline across group projects due to improper privilege assi

IBM Maximo Application Suite Information Disclosure
desc: IBM Maximo Application Suite 8.10, 8.11, 9.0, 9.1, and 9.2 could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system. An attacker could send a specially crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

title: IBM® Db2® is vulnerable to a local attacker with DBADM authorization gaining elevated privileges due to improper privilege management
desc: IBM Db2 11.5.0 through 11.5.9, and 12.1.0 through 12.1.5 for Linux, UNIX and Windows (includes DB2 Connect Server) could allow a local attacker to gain elevated privileges due to improper privilege management.

title: Xerial snappy-java before 1.1.10.9 Unbounded Memory Allocation Denial of Service
desc: Xerial snappy-java before 1.1.10.9 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows attackers to exhaust JVM memory by declaring a large uncompressed length in compressed input. desc: Privasys Remote Attestation TLS Clients provides multi-language utilities for verifying attested TLS connections. desc: dataclasses-avroschema generates Avro schemas from Python dataclasses, Pydantic models, and Faust Records and generates Python code from Avro schemas. GPAC MP4Box filter_queue.c gf_fq_pop use after free
desc: A vulnerability was detected in GPAC up to 26.07.0. This affects the function gf_fq_pop of the file filter_core/filter_queue.c of the component MP4Box. Performing a manipulation results in use after free. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

desc: openapi-typescript-codegen through 0.31.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling an OpenAPI document to inject JavaScript by supplying unescaped values interpolated into single-quoted string literals. desc: hyper-mcp through 0.8.3 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in load_wasm in src/wasm/oci.rs that verifies the Cosign signature of a separately resolved tag rather than the loaded manifest. title: SuiteCRM through 7.15.2 and 8.10.2 Missing Authorization via DetailUserRole Entry Point
desc: SuiteCRM through 7.15.2 and 8.10.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the DetailUserRole entry point that allows authenticated non-admin users to view other users' ACL data. Attackers can supply another non-admin user's id in the record parameter to read that user's assigned roles and per-module ACL action matrix.

title: EdgeEver through 1.108.0 Missing Authorization via Memo-Template API Routes
desc: EdgeEver through 1.108.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Hono API memo-template routes that allows holders of scoped API tokens to bypass token scope restrictions because template handlers never call requireScopes. title: Traccar through 6.16.0 Weak Password Recovery via TokenManager Token Purpose Confusion
desc: Traccar through 6.16.0 contains a weak password recovery vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse password reset tokens as session credentials because TokenManager does not bind tokens to a purpose. desc: A vulnerability was identified in deepseek-ai deepseek-harness up to 0.1.1-rc.2. This affects the function agent of the component dsh-workflow-worker-thread. title: ZKTeco BioTime System Settings API systemSettings access control
desc: A vulnerability was detected in ZKTeco BioTime 9.5.6 Build 20260130.3206. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /base/api/systemSettings of the component System Settings API. Performing a manipulation results in improper access controls. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: APIPark through 1.9.7-beta IDOR via application authorization endpoints
desc: APIPark through 1.9.7-beta contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other applications' credentials by supplying a foreign authorization UUID. Attackers with authorization-view permission on one application can query /api/v1/app/authorization or its details route to retrieve plaintext API keys regardless of HideCredential.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/user/batchEditUsers
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the batchEditUsers handler of SysUserController that allows any authenticated user to edit user department assignments. Low-privileged attackers can send PUT requests to /sys/user/batchEditUsers with arbitrary user and department ids to move users, including administrators, between departments and overwrite positions.

title: Linksys E1700 setVlan stack-based overflow
desc: A vulnerability was identified in Linksys E1700 up to 1.0.0.4.003. This issue affects the function setVlan of the file /goform/setVlan. Such manipulation of the argument vlan_set leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: Netcore NR268 CGI Execution user_ok improper authentication
desc: A vulnerability was determined in Netcore NR268 1.7.121109. Affected is the function user_ok of the component CGI Execution. This manipulation causes improper authentication. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

desc: A vulnerability was determined in 1024-lab smart-admin up to 3.30.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /support/config/queryByKey of the component Support Config Query. title: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/appendix/listFileByBizId
desc: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to list other business objects' file attachments by supplying an arbitrary bizId to the listFileByBizId endpoint. Attackers can retrieve file names, storage paths, MD5 hashes and stored URLs, which in default LOCAL storage are served without login under /anyTenant/file.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 HQL Injection via documents.xml indexed Parameter
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an HQL injection vulnerability in DocumentsDataServlet that allows authenticated users to manipulate queries via the unvalidated indexed parameter. Attackers with read access to any folder can inject boolean HQL expressions to bypass folder scope and read-permission checks, listing restricted document metadata and extracting database contents.

title: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 Missing Authorization via invoice check endpoint
desc: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject invoices via POST /admin-api/crm/invoice/check. The CrmInvoiceController check handler lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, letting attackers bypass the invoice approval workflow by supplying any invoice id.

title: MoguBlog through 6.2 Credential Disclosure via /oauth/getSystemConfig
desc: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged front-end users to read system credentials via the getSystemConfig endpoint. Attackers can supply an ordinary reader session token to retrieve unfiltered SystemConfig data, exposing Qiniu and MinIO secret keys and SMTP mailbox passwords.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /log/list and /log/info
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to read the tenant's operation audit log. Low-privilege users can send GET requests to /log/list or /log/info to view other users' login names, client IP addresses, and actions.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization in DocumentService
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SoapDocumentService operations that allows authenticated users to access and modify unauthorized documents. Attackers can call copy, getExtractedText, deleteVersion, reindex, deleteLink, or restore via SOAP or /services/rest/document with sequential document IDs to disclose, delete, or tamper with documents.

title: SGLang through 0.5.21 Memory Exhaustion DoS via /v1/audio/transcriptions Upload
desc: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by uploading oversized files to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Attackers can send concurrent large multipart uploads, which are fully read into memory before validation, to crash the HTTP/tokenizer worker and deny service.

title: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 Use-After-Free via rdpsnd Disconnect Path
desc: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the static rdpsnd channel disconnect path, which frees audio formats and device without joining play_thread. A malicious RDP server can disconnect while asynchronous Wave2 playback processes queued PDUs, causing the client to read freed heap memory and crash.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 heap buffer overflow via license_check_stream_length
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an integer truncation vulnerability in license_check_stream_length that allows a malicious RDP server to trigger a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit clients. Attackers can send a crafted SERVER_LICENSE_REQUEST with a large scopeCount that bypasses length checks, causing out-of-bounds writes leading to denial of service or remote code execution.

title: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free via -fx Option
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the -fx option that occurs when a memory allocation fails during a specific operation. Attackers who can supply crafted -fx expressions under memory pressure can trigger freed memory access, causing crashes or memory corruption.

title: Open WebUI 0.6.31 before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via Tool-Call Embeds
desc: Open WebUI from 0.6.31 before 0.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in its Markdown renderer, which treats user-authored tool-call details blocks as tool output and mounts their embeds attribute in script-enabled iframes. title: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Remember-Me Cookie
desc: Grav Login plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to skip two-factor authentication through remember-me cookie restoration. Attackers can obtain a persistent remember-me cookie after the password step and restore it as a fully authorized session without completing the second factor.

title: Grav Guestbook Plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 Missing Authorization and CSRF in Moderation
desc: Grav Guestbook plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 contains missing authorization and cross-site request forgery vulnerabilities in Admin moderation actions delete, approve, and approveAll. Authenticated Admin users lacking the admin.guestbook permission, or external sites abusing a moderator's session via nonce-less GET requests, can delete or approve Guestbook entries.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB Headers and RPC use
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 does not check the caller-selected namespace or database against the level at which a namespace- or database-level system user authenticated, allowing cross-tenant access. title: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Memory Exhaustion via Surrealism Module Output Buffering
desc: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 lets Surrealism modules exhaust server memory because module stdout/stderr lines are buffered unbounded in host memory, bypassing the configured module memory limit. An attacker can run an Owner-installed malicious module that writes output without newlines, crashing the server and denying service to all namespaces and databases.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via USE Statement
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 allows cross-tenant access because the SurrealQL USE statement switches a session to any namespace/database without checking that the caller's authenticated level covers it. Authenticated namespace, database, or record users can switch to another tenant and read, create, update, or delete rows in tables whose PERMISSIONS allow it, such as PERMISSIONS FULL.

title: DOMPurify before 3.4.16 XSS via IN_PLACE Returned Rawtext Root
desc: DOMPurify before 3.4.16 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass sanitization because IN_PLACE mode returns a force-removed style element whose text content still carries markup. Attackers can supply a style element containing a closing style tag and an img onerror payload, which executes script when the application serializes and re-parses the returned node.

title: Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 Denial of Service via Malformed v6 Transaction

title: Vercel deepsec before 1.1.17 Arbitrary File Write via Symlink in Sandbox Tarball Extraction
desc: Vercel deepsec from 0.1.0 before 1.1.17 contains a link following vulnerability in extractTarballLocally that allows sandboxed code to write files outside the sandbox by planting links in result tarballs.
